target_customer: Facilitators, trainers and teachers running interactive learning sessions, with organizations as the likely payer
problem: Online learning and training sessions were passive; facilitators lacked tools for active, collaborative activities.
business_model: SaaS subscription for facilitators and teams

founders.name: Jorge Fuentes
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no background given.

founders.name: Nilay Modi
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a later brainstorming tool, Pathspace, under his profile.

exit.reason: Cause not public. YC lists the company as Inactive.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time collaborative canvas and session templates need real-time sync, but this is standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Collaboration canvases were easy for Miro, Mural and Google to extend with templates.

market_need_then: Not documented in found sources; remote teaching and training grew in 2020 but no source about Clayboard states demand.

branding.domain_note: Used clayboard.com, exact match brand domain.
branding.community_and_virality: Public Product Hunt launch listed as June 15, 2022; no evidence of community beyond that.

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found no press on the name or logo; results were about other firms called Clay.

outcome_analysis: Clayboard was a four person New York team in YC Winter 2020 building collaborative learning tools, publicly launched on Product Hunt in June 2022 per a listing. YC lists it Inactive and no source states why or reports any funding, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.
notes: Company site clayboard.com returned 503 so its state is unknown. No funding found in a funding search plus VCBacked profile (no amounts). Competitor list left empty: only undated aggregator pages (Spotsaas, Latka) were found, naming SessionLab, Topicflow, Klaxoon, none dated near the batch. Product Hunt launch date June 2022 is from a search snippet. The 2020 versus 2022 timing and any pivot to Pathspace are not sourced.
